name: clean: a data mount whose service creates its folders at start
why: The other side of data-mount-dirs: the same change with the service creating its folders under the mount at start (the #217 fix) holds, and is approved.

card.sentence: Open a PR: keep the scanner's grype database and temp files in its module data folder
card.reason: pr to the product repo by platform-engineer

chain: Owner: the security scanner downloads grype's vulnerability database again after every restart, and its temp files fill the 1 GB tmpfs. Give it a persistent cache in its module data folder (mounted at /cache) for the database and its temp files, and shrink the tmpfs.
claim: Moves the grype cache to the scanner's data folder and creates its folders at start.
